item.title: Design and Development of a Multi-Functional Robotic Walker
item.description: A Smart Walker with seamless summoning, intuitive navigation, and real-time gait diagnostics.

item.title: Design and Development of a Remote Monitoring Robot for Gait Rehabilitation
item.description: Remote Monitoring Robot for Gait Rehabilitation, adopting a patient-centered approach to robot-assisted gait training while empowering remote clinical oversight.

item.title: Robust summoning capabilities for a Patient Assistive Mobile Robot
item.description: This work presents a Patient Assistive Mobile Robot equipped with robust summoning and navigation capabilities. Our system addresses the crucial need for assistive robots to respond reliably to patients' requests, even in scenarios involving out-of-sight calls.
